name: bamboohr
description: Read and write employee records, paid time off, onboarding, custom fields, and HR reports through the official BambooHR MCP server — a thin wrapper over the BambooHR Open API at api.bamboohr.com.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the BambooHR Open API through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent becomes your HR assistant — looking up employee details, checking who's out today, reviewing PTO balances, or running headcount reports. No more logging into BambooHR for every quick question. Just ask your agent who's on the team, how much time off someone has left, or for a quick update on new hires and departures. Everything happens through conversation, with the employee data you already trust.
defaultPrompt: Who's out of the office today?
Show me a quick headcount report and recent new hires.
